mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 63 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies with a waxing crescent moon. If you are up early, look south toward Belleville at 4:47 AM to catch the International Space Station traveling toward Fitchburg.

The Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various programs and requires a two-shift monthly commitment. Also, be aware that road construction on Highway M begins August 18, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks.

Epic Systems hosts their User Group Meeting today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to Paddy Mac's and the Farmer's Market on Wednesday.
In our weekly report, officers handled several incidents. Specifically, on August 6, a driver was arrested for a fourth O W I offence after an officer observed erratic driving behavior.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10:00 AM.
